text: Mach-3 forward-facing step: lightweight 2D verification Evolve uniform Mach-3 flow with gamma=1.4 to T=4 in [0,3]×[0,1] excluding the step x≥.6,y<.2. Piecewise-constant HLL plus Heun on 60×20,120×40 and240×80 grids compares actual boundary-flux budgets including the step faces, admissibility and shock structure. No corner entropy or enthalpy correction is applied. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. It checks versions,inputs and execution records for stored independent references and distinguishes their reuse from new reference computations. The existing common22-case suite,including quantum convergence,remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts,criteria and history are preserved. Download and execute the supplement Run inside atlas-forward-step-2026-11-23 from the ZIP. This command executes all 1 fixed cases in the supplement. Choose a new or empty output directory. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it. Mach3 forward step: wall budgets and grid verification Actual2D Euler finite volumes evolve60x20,120x40 and240x80 meshes toT4, comparing separately implemented MUSCL finite-grid references. Actual numerical wall fluxes, including the vertical and horizontal step faces, close all four conserved budgets. Figures and code explicitly use the variant without corner entropy correction. Methods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries Nondimensional[0,3]x[0,1] minus solidx>=.6,y<.2; gamma1.4, initial/left-inflow(rho,u,v,p)=(1.4,3,0,1), giving sound speed1 and Mach3. Right zero-gradient outflow; top,bottom and both step faces are slip walls by normal-momentum reflection. Ny multiples of5 align both walls exactly; solid storage is excluded from every fluid norm/integral. No Woodward-Colella corner entropy/enthalpy reset. Editorial clarification A lightweight verification on fixed inputs and a small number of grids. No Woodward–Colella corner entropy/enthalpy correction is applied; the numerical entropy layer from the corner can affect downstream reflected shocks and the Mach stem. It does not establish agreement with the original corner-corrected PPM picture or convergence of fine slip lines and vortices. Adopted numerical method Published Numart piecewise-constant HLL, unsplit x/y divergence and Heun/SSPRK(2,2) become a standalone package. Six boundary categories integrate the actual fluxes at both RK stages with identical weights. CFL.4, at most20000steps per grid. Every predictor/update checks positive density and pressure. Checks cover analytic Mach3 normal-shock Rankine-Hugoniot identities, uniform parallel-channel flow, zero stationary-wall mass/energy flux, step-pressure force orientation, actual four-component budgets and raw failure retention. Newly executed separate C++17 MUSCL/generalized-minmod theta1.5/HLL/Heun references atNy80/160 are conservatively restricted for whole-fluid density/pressure L1 comparison. Ordinary public-ZIP verification reads saved reference data; reference source, contracts and execution records are bundled. The first referenceNy160 exhausted its preregistered120second budget; that actual timeout is preserved. A reference revision removed only unnecessary diagnostic-string allocation and was repinned before first primary execution; physical inputs,arithmetic,CFL and acceptance values did not change. All24 tests, three final-time runs and45 gates passed with-W error. Primary density L1=.14754/.12878/.10265, pressure L1=.19373/.16015/.12242 and last-pair density slope=.327. Reference80/160 increments=.02636/.03063, about.257/.250 of the finest primary differences. Maximum four-component relative boundary-budget residual=2.99e-13; all integrated wall mass/energy fluxes are zero. The three primary grids took about46seconds on the original Mac; revised reference80/160 took about8/65seconds. Verification limits and failures The reference is separately implemented but shares the HLL family and Heun; no external AMROC,LAVA or RKDG engine was executed. Finite-grid numerical data are neither an exact2D solution nor an error bound. Without special corner treatment, a numerical entropy layer may be advected downstream; no agreement with corrected originalPPM fine structures is claimed. Whole-fluid differences,Linf and fixed corner density/pressure/entropy diagnostics are retained. Slopes do not prove pure spatial order; thin slip lines,roll-up,general geometries and high-order convergence remain unverified. Normalized maximum density differences=.592/.670/.665 do not decrease. Corner minima of log(p/rho^gamma)=-.0784/-.1224/-.3510 change substantially. This absolute entropy variable includes an arbitrary additive constant; a more-negative value is not itself an error increase. Neither stable corner extrema nor pointwise pattern convergence is established. Stored measurements and decisions Display values are rounded.
